defs.def: 这家旅馆有没有游泳池？

ex.s: Right across the street, Sonder Lüim Hotel offers spacious rooms and a rooftop pool.
ex.t: 就在街对面，Sonder Lüim酒店提供宽敞的客房和屋顶泳池。

ex.s: Every time I _____25_____ Jacky to something new, he’ll do it only because he trusts me and feels _____26_____ in the knowledge that he won’t get hurt ._____27_____ , teaching Jacky to swim means he has to _____28_____ that, when he’s swimming in the big pool, I’ll come to his rescue if his doggy paddle lets him down.
ex.t: 每次我带Jacky尝试新事物时，他这样做只是因为信任我，并且感到安心，确信自己不会受伤。另外，教Jacky游泳意味着他必须相信，当他在大泳池里游泳时……

ex.s: That said, with a bang of the starting gun, I would dive into the cold water with all my strength and swim to the other side of the pool as fast as I could, only to find that the other swimmers slid past me.
ex.t: 话虽如此，随着发令枪响，我会全力扎进冷水，尽可能快地游到泳池的另一边，却发现其他游泳者从我身边滑过。

ex.s: When at last my hand would grab the edge of the pool, he would always be there with a warm, dry towel, telling me how proud he was of my desperate efforts.
ex.t: 当我的手终于抓住泳池边缘时，他总会拿着一条温暖干燥的毛巾在那里，告诉我他为我的拼命努力感到多么骄傲。

ex.s: Swimming pools and beaches are crowded with people trying to cool down.
ex.t: 游泳池和海滩挤满了试图降温的人。

ex.s: The larger towns and cities have many facilities for their , such as football fields, swimming pools, and courses.
ex.t: 较大的城镇和城市为市民提供了许多设施，如足球场、游泳池和（高尔夫）球场。

ex.s: The finishing touches are now being put to a new swimming pool and our workout rooms have been updated with modern equipment.
ex.t: 新游泳池正在进行最后的收尾工作，我们的健身房也更新了现代化设备。

defs.def: a small area of still water, especially one that has formed naturally 水坑，水塘，池塘（尤指自然形成的）
a small amount of liquid or light lying on a surface 一滩（液体）；一小片（液体或光）

ex.s: There is a large pool of mud, and a group of young people are jumping into it and swimming around.
ex.t: 有一个大泥浆池，一群年轻人正在跳进去四处游着。

defs.def: a supply of things or money that is shared by a group of people and can be used when needed 共用的资源（或资金）

ex.s: Via the Internet, assets are exchanged and resources are pooled, providing products, services, knowledge and skills.
ex.t: 通过互联网，资产得以交换，资源得以共享，提供产品、服务、知识和技能。

defs.def: a group of people available for work when needed （统称）备用人员
a game for two people played with 16 balls on a table, often in pubs and bars. Players use cues (= long sticks) to try to hit the balls into pockets at the edge of the table. 普尔；落袋台球；弹子球；（台）落袋撞球
他每周都去赌足球普尔。
